 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Timberwolves guards LaMelo Ball and Terrence Shannon Jr. have been added to the team's injury report ahead of Monday night's home game against the Milwaukee Bucks.
 Ball is questionable to play with a right wrist contusion. It's his first appearance on the injury report this season.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement It's possible this wrist issue is something Ball has been dealing with for a couple games now. The Timberwolves' broadcast showed him testing out his right wrist at the very end of last Wednesday's game against the Warriors. He played in Minnesota's back-to-back games against the Clippers and Spurs over the weekend.
